mapper.select: SELECT m.*, COALESCE(um.is_read, 0) AS is_read FROM message m LEFT JOIN user_message um ON m.id = um.message_id AND um.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND (m.scope = 1 OR um.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message m LEFT JOIN user_message um ON m.id = um.message_id AND um.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND (m.scope = 1 OR um.user_id = #{userId}) AND (um.is_read IS NULL OR um.is_read = 0)
